citation_short: Multisensory integration in PPS indexes consciousness states (2026)
confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback extraction, rendered STAR Methods pages, and the user-provided Cell Press article-export PDF were checked. The paper supplies enough Segment 1-4 metadata for static near/far PPS stimulation in healthy wake/sleep and DoC arm variants, but it reports no original code or scripts and no dynamic looming trajectory.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The study can be recreated as static near/far audio-tactile PPS stimulation for task-free EEG/clinical endpoints. It is not a behavioral RT profile and not a moving looming profile; exact white-noise assets, participant-specific gains, and some sleep-block totals would need protocol-level choices.

source_checks.scope: Checked article resource availability and STAR Methods around stimulus delivery, participant variants, EEG epochs, stimulation procedure, and counts.
Extracted from the user-provided Cell Press ZIP; reviewed pages 11 and 16-18 for resource/code notes and STAR Methods.
Used as the initial extracted text map, then corrected against the Cell Press PDF and rendered STAR Methods pages.
Searched the extracted Cell Press source text for stimulus, apparatus, randomization, ITI, baseline, count, sleep, DoC, and code/script terms.
Temporary rendered STAR Methods pages were visually checked and not committed.

review_attempts.result: Mapped noisy candidate Segment 1-4 values and identified the need to separate analysis frequencies from stimulus parameters.
Found a 43-PDF Cell Press export batch; extracted only the relevant article PDF for this record and found no scripts or code files.
Separated the healthy chest and DoC arm task variants and captured white-noise duration, speaker geometry, gain, and tactile apparatus.

review_attempts.strategy: Timing, SOA, ITI, and jitter pass
review_attempts.result: Confirmed synchronous audio-tactile onset, healthy awake ITI 2.5-3 s in five 100 ms steps, and DoC ITI uniformly 1.5-2 s.
Confirmed five randomized conditions per block, healthy awake 3 x 110-trial blocks, sleep stim/no-stim blocks, and DoC 250-trial blocks.

review_attempts.strategy: Baseline, response, catch, and count pass
review_attempts.result: Captured EEG baseline windows, sleep no-stimulation blocks, no per-trial behavioral response, and no catch/no-go trial family.
Resource availability statements and the Cell Press ZIP show no original code or reusable stimulus-generation scripts.

stimulus_type.value: Healthy variant used 100 ms white-noise bursts; DoC variant used 50 ms white-noise bursts.
stimulus_type.page_or_section: PDF pp.16-18, STAR Methods, Experimental Design
stimulus_type.evidence_note: Both participant variants identify white-noise auditory stimulation and duration.

source_provenance.value: Healthy sounds were generated with E-Prime 2; resource notes report no original code. Exact white-noise file, seed, or reusable script is not supplied.
source_provenance.page_or_section: PDF pp.11, 16, Resource Availability and STAR Methods
source_provenance.evidence_note: The source route gives software provenance but no code or asset bundle.

trajectory_count.value: Two static auditory distance conditions per variant: near and far, crossed with unisensory and audio-tactile condition families.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: AN/AF and ANT/AFT rows encode near/far auditory distance rather than motion.

trajectory_path.value: Healthy: speakers at 30 cm or 130 cm above the chest. DoC: speakers at 5 cm or 75 cm from the extended arm in depth.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Both variants specify body anchor and near/far speaker distances.

stimulus_duration.value: Auditory duration was 100 ms in the healthy wake/sleep variant and 50 ms in the DoC patient variant.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Duration values are explicit for both auditory-stimulus variants.

stimulus_speed.value: No auditory movement speed is applicable; stimulation used static near/far loudspeaker positions, not looming or receding motion.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: Near/far positions are reported, but no moving-source trajectory is described.

auditory_conditions.value: Five conditions were used: tactile only, auditory near, auditory far, audio-tactile near, and audio-tactile far.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The same condition family appears in healthy and DoC procedures.

gain_envelope.value: Healthy: individual auditory threshold plus 40%, mean 51 dB, equalized at the ear. DoC: 65.2 dB SPL near and 64.1 dB SPL far.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Intensity calibration is reported; no detailed waveform envelope is supplied.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Healthy: two commercial loudspeakers, E-Prime 2, Digitimer DS7AH. DoC: Logitech Z120 speakers and MEDEL Motionstim 8 FES setup.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Speaker and tactile-device apparatus are reported for both variants.

trial_rows_families.value: Both variants use T, AN, AF, ANT, and AFT rows; sleep additionally alternates stimulation and no-stimulation block families.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: Condition rows and sleep no-stimulation blocks are described in the procedure.

condition_intermixing.value: Awake healthy and DoC trials were fully randomized within blocks; sleep stimulation/no-stimulation blocks were randomized independently of sleep stage.
condition_intermixing.page_or_section: PDF pp.16-18, Experimental Design and Procedure
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The randomization rule is explicit for trials and sleep blocks.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Healthy awake: three randomized 110-trial blocks. Sleep: 5-min stimulation/no-stimulation blocks. DoC: 10-min randomized blocks.
blocked_or_random_order.page_or_section: PDF pp.16-18, Experimental Design and Procedure
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Block duration and trial randomization are reported by participant variant.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Healthy awake ITI was 2.5-3 s in five random 100 ms steps. DoC ITI was uniformly distributed from 1.5-2 s.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: ITI and jitter/distribution are explicitly reported for awake healthy and DoC protocols.

response_window.value: No per-trial behavioral response window is applicable; the PPS stimulation task was task-free EEG/clinical assessment.
response_window.page_or_section: PDF pp.16-18, Experimental Design and Procedure
response_window.evidence_note: Participants were not required to respond during PPS stimulation trials.

task_sequence_rules.value: Healthy sleep used stimulation and no-stimulation block alternation with awakenings/questionnaires; DoC blocks included brief clinical breaks.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Sequence constraints differ for sleep-state and clinical-patient procedures.

tactile_stimulus.value: Healthy: 5 ms electrical chest pulse below the manubrium via DS7AH. DoC: 50 ms, 35 Hz FES to arm extensors at 70% motor threshold.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Tactile site, duration, device, and calibration are reported for both variants.

soa_table.value: Audio-tactile near and far trials used synchronized auditory and tactile onset; no SOA ladder was manipulated.
soa_table.evidence_note: The multisensory conditions specify simultaneous or onset-synchronized delivery.

baseline_strategy.value: Controls include tactile-only and auditory-only rows, sleep no-stimulation blocks, and EEG baseline correction rather than a behavioral tactile SOA baseline.
baseline_strategy.page_or_section: PDF pp.16-18, Experimental Design and Quantification
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Baseline strategy combines control rows, sleep blocks, and EEG preprocessing.

baseline_timing.value: Healthy EEG epochs used -1 to +2 s around stimulus onset. DoC epochs used -100 to +500 ms with a 100 ms pre-stimulus baseline.
baseline_timing.page_or_section: PDF pp.17-18, Quantification and Statistical Analysis
baseline_timing.evidence_note: EEG baseline windows are reported separately for healthy and DoC analyses.

catch_trial_type.value: No catch or no-go trial family is described; auditory-only rows are unisensory control conditions, not catches.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: The task is response-free, with no target-absent catch requirement.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Healthy awake: 22 trials per condition per block, three blocks. DoC: 50 trials per condition per 250-trial block.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Per-condition counts are reported for awake healthy and DoC blocks.

baseline_count.value: Sleep baseline is specified as alternating 5-min no-stimulation blocks; EEG baseline windows are timing windows, not discrete trial counts.
baseline_count.evidence_note: No-stimulation block duration is reported; no separate behavioral baseline count applies.

catch_count.value: No catch trials are described, so no catch count applies.
catch_count.evidence_note: The trial rows are active unisensory or multisensory conditions.

block_count.value: Healthy awake: three blocks. Sleep: repeated 5-min blocks overnight. DoC: mean 2.8 blocks per session, range 1-3.
block_count.page_or_section: PDF pp.16-18, Experimental Design and Procedure
block_count.evidence_note: Block counts or block-duration rules are reported by participant variant.

total_trial_count.value: Healthy awake totals 330 trials from 3 x 110. DoC totals 250-750 trials depending on 1-3 blocks, with 250 trials per block.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Totals are derived from reported block and per-block counts.
